# iaas_microvm_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists the account's sandbox disk snapshots, newest first. Use an id as snapshot_id on iaas_microvm to start a sandbox from it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find a snapshot by name and start sandboxes from it.
data "iaas_microvm_snapshots" "golden" {
  name   = "golden-image"
  status = "ready"
}

resource "iaas_microvm" "worker" {
  count       = 3
  name        = "worker-${count.index}"
  snapshot_id = data.iaas_microvm_snapshots.golden.snapshots[0].id
  # The location is the snapshot's own. The plan must hold the snapshot's root filesystem: any plan when it is 2 GiB or less, otherwise a plan disk of at least its size in whole GiB (disk_gib is the source's plan, not the test).
  plan_id = var.plan_id
  network = [{ kind = "public" }]
  env     = { ROLE = "worker" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only the snapshot with exactly this name.
- `sandbox_id` (String) Only snapshots taken from this sandbox.
- `status` (String) Only snapshots in this status: creating, ready, failed, deleting or unavailable.

### Read-Only

- `snapshots` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `billable_gib` (Number) Whole GiB billed per hour.
- `capture_method` (String) reflink, paused_copy or offline_copy.
- `consistency` (String) quiesced, crash or clean.
- `created_at` (String) When it was requested.
- `description` (String) Free text.
- `disk_gib` (Number) Disk size in GiB; a plan must have at least this much to start a sandbox from the snapshot.
- `failure_reason` (String) Why a failed snapshot failed.
- `id` (String) Snapshot UUID.
- `image_id` (String) Image the source sandbox ran.
- `kind` (String) disk.
- `location_id` (String) Location the snapshot is stored in.
- `mem_mib` (Number) Memory of the source sandbox in MiB.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name.
- `paused_ms` (Number) Milliseconds the sandbox was paused.
- `price_gib_hour` (Number) Price per GiB-hour of stored space.
- `ready_at` (String) When it became ready.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Disk size in bytes.
- `source_sandbox_id` (String) Sandbox the snapshot was taken from; null once that sandbox is deleted.
- `source_state` (String) running, paused or stopped when it was taken.
- `status` (String) creating, ready, failed, deleting or unavailable.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes actually stored.
- `vcpu` (Number) vCPUs of the source sandbox.
- `volumes_excluded` (Number) How many data volumes of the sandbox are NOT in this snapshot (it holds the root disk only).
